metaDescription: Order custom wool duffle gym bags in bulk. Perfect for corporate gifts or team gear. Get a quote today.
introHtml: Wool duffle gym bags offer a natural, premium alternative to synthetic options. The material provides insulation for temperature-sensitive items and resists odors, making it ideal for athletes who carry gear from workout to meeting. The Field & Co.® Campster 22" Duffel Bag showcases how wool can be combined with leather accents for a sophisticated look. Custom embroidery or screen printing adds your logo without compromising the fabric's texture.
heroAltText: Custom wool duffle gym bag with leather trim and embroidered logo, ideal for corporate gifts or team gear.
